propositions: the loud refusal at runner.py:718 currently rejects any base_url/api_key configuration despite documentation and parsed config keys supporting them
a builder must register the openai provider only when base_url is configured, injecting it into OpenAIProvider while leaving selection to REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER
the builder must override the model profile to withdraw supports_json_schema_output=False for opaque endpoints while preserving other capabilities like tools
base_url must not act as an implicit provider selector; bare openai:model without base_url takes the lazy pydantic-ai path unchanged
pydantic-ai-slim[openai] must be added to dev dependencies only to enable testing, keeping the agents runtime extra lean and opt-in
api_key without base_url and non-absolute base_url must raise validation errors with clear messages; missing sdk must raise a named install command
